title: Phase 3 sampling details: sea cells excluded from background, sampling streams, inputs
basis: Phase 2 terrain blocks exist (extent-wide distributions only, reports/susceptibility_v02/phase2_terrain_*.json). No v02 sample, no value at any landslide, no model. Decision approved by the user on 2026-10-18.

sampling.background_rule.min_elevation_r.value: a background cell is rejected if its NASADEM elevation on the 30 m working grid (v02 terrain block, bilinear) is <= 0 m (sea / NASADEM ocean fill); rejections are counted per inventory. Applies identically to every inventory. Positives are not filtered by elevation; their number at <= 0 m is reported.
sampling.background_rule.min_elevation_r.reason: About 2.6 % of the Iburi GSI interpretation extent (about 36 km2 along the Pacific coast) has NASADEM elevation exactly 0 m: the provider's extent includes sea. Area-uniform background there would be trivially landslide-free and inflate every AUC, including the slope baseline. The rule is derived from the DEM, not from the landslides. Gorkha and Far-Western Nepal have no cell <= 0 m in their extents, so the rule does not change them.

value.terrain_source: v02 terrain blocks (data/susceptibility_v02/terrain), corrected tile-lattice merge; v01 blocks are not used for v02 samples
value.rng_stream: numpy default_rng([seeds.sampling, k]) with k the index of the inventory in the sorted list of sampled inventories (far_western_nepal, gorkha_2015, iburi_2018); positives are drawn first in polygon file order, then background
value.positive_definitions: gorkha_2015: Source20170209.shp, uniform among cells in the source area; far_western_nepal: v01 Amendment 1 positive_filter (minimum dated year >= 2001), top elevation third; iburi_2018: Amendment 1 and 2 (3,177 GSI polygons), top elevation third. Duplicated cells and cells outside the extent are counted and dropped.
value.background_definitions: area-uniform 30 m cells inside the mapping extent minus (all known landslide polygons buffered by exclusion_buffer_m, plus obscured areas), min_separation_m apart, NASADEM elevation finite and > 0 m
value.block_id: 5 km square blocks on the working CRS grid: '<dataset>:<floor(x/5000)>:<floor(y/5000)>' (bootstrap and permutation unit of the registered evaluation)
value.pga: gorkha_2015 and iburi_2018 samples carry log10_pga_pctg from their frozen ShakeMap grid.xml (bilinear PGA in percent g, then log10); far_western_nepal has no PGA
value.rain_arm: rer2023 stays pending_extent and is not sampled

sampling.implementation.reason: Fixes the remaining sampling choices in writing before any v02 sample is drawn.

preconditions: registration present; nothing from stage 'samples' on existed
